prompts.name: gamers-station
prompts.label: 게이머즈 역
prompts.extra: A playful game-themed station entrance inspired by a virtual idol gaming group. Central metal double entrance, wide sign above with a simple gamepad silhouette, subtle small white fox ears on left sign end and brown dog ears on right end, muted forest green accents, two small ticket machines inset beside doors. Clean compact industrial transit architecture, clearly a station not a merchandise shop.
